pages.title: Deciphering Rewards
pages.text: Each solved Ancient Book has an equal chance to become one of these manuals:$(li)Sword Flight Manual$(li)Break and Rebuild Manual$(li)Myriad Swords Return Manual$(li)Supreme Alchemy Canon$(br2)These manuals do not generate directly in wild loot chests.

pages.title: Sword Flight Manual
pages.text: Right-click to learn the extra skill Sword Flight. A successful study consumes the manual outside Creative mode. A player who already knows the skill does not consume it again.

pages.title: Myriad Swords Return
pages.text: Right-click to learn the extra skill Myriad Swords Return. A successful study consumes the manual outside Creative mode. A player who already knows the skill does not consume it again.

pages.title: Break and Rebuild
pages.text: A meridian-restoring art intended for the Wastelander race. When its conditions are met, right-clicking the manual sheds that broken state and opens a cultivation path.

pages.title: Supreme Alchemy Canon
pages.text: Right-click to comprehend Alchemy Prodigy. If the skill is already known, studying instead increases its mastery until it is fully mastered.
